text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More congratulations for President Hafez al-Assad on Eid al-Fitr.
- Arab League underscores support for Syria's stand on peace process.
- Iran celebrates 18th anniversary of revolution. President Assad congratulates Iran's leaders on the occasion.
- Jordanian parties call for backing Syria's stance on peace.
- French President Jacques Chirac meets Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri in Paris today.
- Lebanese Foreign Minister Faris Bouez: "Israel's attitude still far from peace bases."
- Jordanian parties call for renewal of Arab boycott of Israel.
- Italy reiterates support for Lebanon's call for liberation of its areas occupied by Israel.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates rejection to withdrawl from the Golan.

- Israel says it will decide the extent and timing of the redeployment of its troops in the west bank. Palestinian President Yasser Arafat pledged to Netanyahu to chase and arrest Palestinian opposition members.
- British media say Hebron agreement between Israel and the Palestinans had escalated tension.
